correctness.rationale: Working over algebraically closed characteristic 3 with two smooth infinity charts, f=t^8+b^3 t^6+a^3 t^2+1 has derivative -t(t^2+a)^3; evaluated at the candidate multiple roots it vanishes exactly when ab=1. Independent symbolic characteristic-3 calculation confirmed this and f=(t^2+a)^3(t^2+b^3) when ab=1. Off the boundary genus=3; Hasse–Witt matrix [[a^3,0,1],[0,0,0],[1,0,b^3]], with 2x2 semilinear invertible block (ab)^3-1, gives p-rank2 and a-number1. Involutions t->-t give smooth supersingular elliptic and ordinary genus2 quotients; degree-two maps induce prime-to-3 Jacobian isogeny. At ab=1,a^4!=1, two triple-root cusps normalize to a genus1 quartic and Pic0 extension by Ga^2; elliptic Hasse coefficient (a^4+1)/a^3 singles out four supersingular parameters. If a^4=1, f=(t^2+a)^4 splits into two rational graphs with exactly two contact-two tacnodes; local unit gluing yields Gm x Ga^2. Infinity is smooth in all cases. The local normalization and Picard arguments are geometric, not settled by finite symbolic checks alone.
